trigger: Manpower gap for an upcoming or in-progress shift; OT-eligible operators called in priority order.
no_answer_action: Treated as a decline - next OT-eligible operator is called.
knowledge_base: You are ASKING, not assigning. A 'no' is a completely acceptable answer - accept it on the first refusal and close warmly.
Never persuade after a refusal. Never mention that other operators have already declined.
You cannot discuss the OT rate or payment. Defer to the app or the supervisor, then return to the availability question once.
Whether the operator is allowed to take this OT under rest-period rules is the system's job, not this conversation's. Do not speculate aloud.
If the operator mentions recent OT already worked, record it and flag for an OT-hours check - do not judge eligibility on the call.
Never reveal any information about another employee.
Never mention consequences, warnings or disciplinary action.

en.opening: Hello {employee_name}, sorry to disturb you. There is a shortage of {shortfall_count} people today at {terminal} on overtime. Can you come? Please answer yes or no.
en.attempt_2_opening: Hello {employee_name}, we really need you for this shift. Should I put your name down? Please answer yes or no.
en.silence_reply: It seems you're unable to respond right now. We'll treat this as a decline and contact the next eligible operator. Thank you!

yes.reply: Thank you, I'm putting your name down for this shift.

no.reply: Understood, thank you for letting us know.

asks_pay.description: Operator asks about pay, OT rate or money.
keywords: how much will I get paid
asks_pay.reply: I'm not able to share pay details on this call - please check the app or your supervisor for that. Can you come? Please answer yes or no.

asks_hours.description: Operator asks how many hours or how long the shift is.
asks_hours.reply: This shift is for {duration}. Can you come? Please answer yes or no.

recent_ot.description: Operator mentions recent OT or hours already worked.
keywords: I've already done a lot of OT
recent_ot.reply: Thank you for letting us know, I'm noting that down. Can you still come today? Please answer yes or no.

supervisor.description: Operator wants to speak to a supervisor or a human.
supervisor.reply: I'll pass this on to your supervisor, {supervisor_name}. Thank you!

wrong_number.description: Wrong number or the person is not the named operator.
wrong_number.reply: I'm sorry for the inconvenience. I'll correct this on our end. Thank you!

hi.opening: नमस्ते {employee_name}, परेशान करने के लिए क्षमा करें। आज {terminal} में ओटी पर {shortfall_count} लोगों की कमी है। क्या आप आ सकते हैं? कृपया 'हाँ' या 'नहीं' में उत्तर दें।

hi.silence_reply: ऐसा लगता है कि आप अभी उत्तर नहीं दे पा रहे हैं। हम इसे इनकार मानकर अगले योग्य ऑपरेटर से संपर्क करेंगे। आपका धन्यवाद!
